body_md:
People looking for an independently owned electrical contractor in Cape Coral can compare six listings that each name an owner and a checked Florida license. Every license is a Certified Electrical Contractor with status Current, Active in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup, and each fact set links to that licensee detail page.

## How we picked

Licenses were checked in the Florida DBPR licensee lookup. Each is a Certified Electrical Contractor, status Current, Active, expiring 08/31/2028, and each fact set links to its DBPR licensee detail page. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-02. Southwest Florida Electric, Inc. is listed at 2565 South St, Fort Myers, FL 33901, and serves Cape Coral. The other five addresses are in Cape Coral.

## At a glance

- Licensure dates: Nassau Electric Corporation, EC13003074, 11/08/2005 (qualifier COLLEY, GARY A); All Power Electric & Air, LLC, EC13003326, 08/02/2006 (LEWIS, KEITH HERBERT); Southwest Florida Electric, Inc., EC13004490, 05/25/2010 (HENKEL, JARON R); ACRA Electric, Inc., EC13005523, 09/23/2013 (GRECO, MICHAEL ANTHONY); Perfect Connections Electrical Contractor, LLC, EC13005873, 01/22/2014 (HEARD, JOSHUA ROCKY); Phoenix Electric and Air LLC, EC13008211, 11/21/2017 (VASQUEZ, JOSE N).
- Service areas: ACRA Electric, Southwest Florida; All Power Electric & Air, Southwest Florida, including Cape Coral, Fort Myers, North Fort Myers, Lehigh Acres, Estero, and Bonita Springs; Perfect Connections, all of Southwest Florida; Southwest Florida Electric, Cape Coral, Fort Myers, Naples, and surrounding areas in Lee, Collier, and Charlotte Counties. Service area is not listed for Phoenix Electric and Air or Nassau Electric Corporation.
- Hours: Perfect Connections, Monday-Friday 7 am to 4 pm; Phoenix Electric and Air, Monday to Friday 9:00 am – 5:00 pm; Southwest Florida Electric, open 24 hours, 7 days a week. Hours are not listed for ACRA Electric, All Power Electric & Air, or Nassau Electric Corporation.
- Business dates: ACRA Electric since 1975; Nassau Electric Corporation incorporated January 20, 1999; All Power Electric & Air founded 2006; Southwest Florida Electric since 2010; Phoenix Electric and Air founded at the beginning of 2021. Years in business are not listed for Perfect Connections.

## Things to know before you go

Named owners are Anthony and Carmella Greco (founders; family-operated, with Michael Anthony Greco as qualifying licensee) at ACRA Electric; Michelle and Keith Lewis at All Power Electric & Air; Joshua Rocky Heard at Perfect Connections; Jose N. Vasquez at Phoenix Electric and Air; Gary A. Colley and Karin L. Colley at Nassau Electric Corporation; and Jessica Giannakis-Henkel and Jaron R. Henkel at Southwest Florida Electric. ACRA Electric and Southwest Florida Electric are described as family-owned.

Prices are not listed for any of the six. Upfront pricing is listed for Perfect Connections and Southwest Florida Electric. Perfect Connections also lists free estimates and a 1-year workmanship/product warranty. A satisfaction guarantee is stated on the Southwest Florida Electric site. A phone and website are not listed for Nassau Electric Corporation.

ACRA Electric lists residential, commercial, service, and marine electrical work. All Power Electric & Air lists residential and commercial electrical repairs and installs, heating and cooling, and air-conditioning license CA1818688 on its site. Perfect Connections lists residential and commercial work, new construction, remodeling, pool/spa wiring, generators, and EV charging. Phoenix Electric and Air lists lighting, outlets, surge arrestors, fans, standby and portable generator installs, and HVAC installs, repairs, and maintenance. Southwest Florida Electric lists electrical repair, wiring, lighting, generator installation, and panel services. Features are not listed for Nassau Electric Corporation.

## FAQ

### Are these licenses current?

Yes. All six are Certified Electrical Contractor licenses marked Current, Active, expiring 08/31/2028. Each fact set links to its Florida DBPR licensee detail page. Contacts were checked on 2026-11-02.

### Which records mention Cape Coral?

All Power Electric & Air names Cape Coral in its service area. Southwest Florida Electric names Cape Coral and is listed in Fort Myers. ACRA Electric lists Southwest Florida, and Perfect Connections lists all of Southwest Florida. Phoenix Electric and Air and Nassau Electric Corporation have Cape Coral addresses; a service area is not listed for either.

### What hours and prices are listed?

No prices are listed. Hours are listed for Perfect Connections, Phoenix Electric and Air, and Southwest Florida Electric, and are not listed for ACRA Electric, All Power Electric & Air, or Nassau Electric Corporation.
